description: Open a registered foreign Postgres connection and confirm it: the resolved host it actually connected to, the server version, the current role, and the read-only flag (always true). Use it to verify a connection points where you expect (the host you registered) before trusting it. Requires connection_name. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) — the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the job finishing; the confirmation is delivered when the job completes.
embedding_description: Open a real read-only connection to a registered external Postgres database and report what it actually reached: resolved host, server version, and the role the stored credential authenticates as. Confirm a connection points at the database and user you expect before trusting it. Dispatches asynchronously; the confirmation arrives via job completion.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the connection confirmation — that arrives separately when the job completes and is delivered as its own message.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the job was queued — do not present job_id/status as the connection confirmation itself. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the confirmation (ok, resolved host, server_version, current_user, read_only) lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, report the resolved host, server version, and connecting role; flag it if the host or role looks different from what was intended (e.g. the role looks more privileged than a read-only user should be).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Open and confirm a registered foreign Postgres connection.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: external_pg.invalid_params: missing connection_name. external_pg.connection_unknown: no connection registered under that name. external_pg.auth_failed: the registered credential was rejected. external_pg.platform_db_refused: the connection targets the platform's own database instance (refused). external_pg.api_error: the database could not be reached.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: external_pg.connection_unknown: run list_connections. external_pg.auth_failed: ask the operator to re-check the registered credential. external_pg.api_error: verify the database is reachable from this host.
